teaser: Four drafts of the same proposal sit open in different tabs, each one a little closer to something that could actually stand. That patience belongs to the 22 in you, the number known as the Master Builder, crossed with an INFP's refusal to ship anything that does not feel true all the way through. The 22 wants a structure the world can use. The INFP wants that structure to mean something before it is allowed to exist. Neither half is satisfied by a plan that only works, or a feeling that never becomes one. What is particular here is the patience to hold both demands at once, for years if that is what it takes.
